NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Ilana Glazer discussed the societal impact of AI at a public event in Manhattan.

Mamdani criticized the narrative of inevitable adoption, highlighting his recent ban on AI tools in public schools and new mandatory disclosure policies for real estate ads.

The conversation also covered federal regulatory shortcomings and the long-term outlook for major AI labs, including upcoming IPO…
